target.statement: Estimation accuracy of I(X,k0,k1)* vs MLE covariance inverse for Gaussian data: average log Frobenius error at a given (n,p), e.g. n=1000, p=10 (Figure 2a point)
target.dataset: Synthetic Gaussian data (random covariance from Stiefel eigenvectors, Exponential(1) eigenvalues)

compute.basis: Synthetic data generation plus kNN-based DIM estimator and covariance inversion on small p (10-500), n up to 2000, 50 replicates; all CPU, but the method must be re-implemented from the paper since no code is released.

blockers: No code released; nnDIM estimator, bias correction and orthogonalisation must be re-implemented from equations
Exact random covariance generation (Stiefel sampling) and error metric details must be inferred
title: Efficient Estimation of High Information Projections using Nearest Neighbours
